Minister Goyal Discusses Retail Investment With Nippon Life India CEO

Union Minister Piyush Goyal met with Sundeep Sikka, the CEO of Nippon Life India Asset Management Company, to discuss strategies for increasing retail investment in India. The meeting focused on scaling up these investments. The discussions took place between the minister and the CEO of the asset management firm.
